name: posting.legit
description: Is this posting a real, current, fillable seat? Filters ghost jobs, evergreen pipeline posts, staffing-agency mass reposts and stale listings before any effort is spent.

ghost_signals.instructions: Signs this posting is not a real, currently open seat (evergreen wording, no team or manager context, identical text across many cities, posted 60+ days, generic 'always hiring')
criteria: No ghost signals; specific team, manager context and recent date
Several signals; likely pipeline or evergreen
Almost certainly not a fillable seat right now

agency_repost.instructions: The poster is a staffing agency or recruiter reposting a client's role rather than the employer itself

direct_employer.instructions: The posting names the employer and the team the role sits in

urgency.instructions: The text implies an active search with a named timeline, backfill, or new funding for the seat

rules.reason: agency repost -- find the direct employer posting first

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
